title: Acadian Boat Tours

services.name: Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Join us for a two hour, fully-narrated nature cruise of Frenchman Bay and enjoy the breathtaking scenery of coastal Maine, Acadia National Park, the islands of Frenchman Bay and Bar Harbor. Our Acadian Sightseeing /Nature cruises leave daily from Bar Harbor, Maine in search of eagles, porpoises, seals, and other interesting marine mammals and birds. We also feature views of timeless mansions, Egg Rock Lighthouse and occasionally migrating birds that have ventured into Frenchman Bay. Cruise by some highlights of Acadia National Park, learn about the history of Mt. Desert Island and simply enjoy the spectacular views on this scenic cruise. services.desc: Bring your camera, your favorite people and your relaxed state of mind for this spectacular 3 & 1/4 hour Somes Sound Fjord, Photography & Wildlife tour! View the vintage homes of Northeast and Seal Harbors, the quaint village of Southwest Harbor and cruise with our captain through beautiful Somes Sound into the only fjord on the east coast. We will see both Egg Rock and Bear Island Lighthouses along with the shoreline of Acadia National Park and her best highlights including Thunderhole, Great Head and Sand Beach.
